verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיִקְחוּ־לִ֖י תְּרוּמָ֑ה מֵאֵ֤ת כָּל־אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדְּבֶ֣נּוּ לִבֹּ֔ו תִּקְח֖וּ אֶת־תְּרוּמָתִֽי׃
verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَنْ يَأْخُذُوا لِي تَقْدِمَةً. مِنْ كُلِّ مَنْ يَحِثُّهُ قَلْبُهُ تَأْخُذُونَ تَقْدِمَتِي.
verses.en: 'Speak unto the children of Israel, that they take for Me an offering; of every man whose heart maketh him willing ye shall take My offering.
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

verses.he: וְזֹאת֙ הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּקְח֖וּ מֵאִתָּ֑ם זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ هِيَ ٱلتَّقْدِمَةُ ٱلَّتِي تَأْخُذُونَهَا مِنْهُمْ: ذَهَبٌ وَفِضَّةٌ وَنُحَاسٌ،
verses.en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them: gold, and silver, and brass;
verses.kjv: And this [is] the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.web: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

verses.he: וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתֹולַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَأَسْمَانْجُونِيٌّ وَأُرْجُوَانٌ وَقِرْمِزٌ وَبُوصٌ وَشَعْرُ مِعْزَى،
verses.en: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair;
verses.kjv: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ [hair],
verses.web: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

verses.he: וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَجُلُودُ كِبَاشٍ مُحَمَّرَةٌ وَجُلُودُ تُخَسٍ وَخَشَبُ سَنْطٍ،
verses.en: and rams' skins dyed red, and sealskins, and acacia-wood;
verses.kjv: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
verses.web: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

verses.he: שֶׁ֖מֶן לַמָּאֹ֑ר בְּשָׂמִים֙ לְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَزَيْتٌ لِلْمَنَارَةِ وَأَطْيَابٌ لِدُهْنِ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ وَلِلْبَخُورِ ٱلْعَطِرِ،
verses.en: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense;
verses.kjv: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.web: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

verses.he: אַבְנֵי־שֹׁ֕הַם וְאַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפֹ֖ד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.ar: وَحِجَارَةُ جَزْعٍ وَحِجَارَةُ تَرْصِيعٍ لِلرِّدَاءِ وَٱلصُّدْرَةِ.
verses.en: onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.kjv: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.web: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

verses.he: וְעָ֥שׂוּ לִ֖י מִקְדָּ֑שׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֖י בְּתֹוכָֽם׃
verses.ar: فَيَصْنَعُونَ لِي مَقْدِسًا لِأَسْكُنَ فِي وَسَطِهِمْ.
verses.en: And let them make Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
verses.kjv: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.web: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

verses.he: כְּכֹ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אֹותְךָ֔ אֵ֚ת תַּבְנִ֣ית הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת תַּבְנִ֣ית כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְכֵ֖ן תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃ ס
verses.ar: بِحَسَبِ جَمِيعِ مَا أَنَا أُرِيكَ مِنْ مِثَالِ ٱلْمَسْكَنِ، وَمِثَالِ جَمِيعِ آنِيَتِهِ هَكَذَا تَصْنَعُونَ.
verses.en: According to all that I show thee, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the furniture thereof, even so shall ye make it.
verses.kjv: According to all that I shew thee, [after] the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make [it].
verses.web: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

verses.he: וְעָשׂ֥וּ אֲרֹ֖ון עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אָרְכֹּ֗ו וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֙צִי֙ רָחְבֹּ֔ו וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: «فَيَصْنَعُونَ تَابُوتًا مِنْ خَشَبِ ٱلسَّنْطِ، طُولُهُ ذِرَاعَانِ وَنِصْفٌ، وَعَرْضُهُ ذِرَاعٌ وَنِصْفٌ، وَٱرْتِفَاعُهُ ذِرَاعٌ وَنِصْفٌ.
verses.en: And they shall make an ark of acacia-wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.kjv: ¶ And they shall make an ark [of] shittim wood: two cubits and a half [shall be] the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.web: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

verses.he: וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתֹו֙ זָהָ֣ב טָהֹ֔ור מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ תְּצַפֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עָלָ֛יו זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.ar: وَتُغَشِّيهِ بِذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ. مِنْ دَاخِلٍ وَمِنْ خَارِجٍ تُغَشِّيهِ، وَتَصْنَعُ عَلَيْهِ إِكْلِيلًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ حَوَالَيْهِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

verses.he: וְיָצַ֣קְתָּ לֹּ֗ו אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל־צַלְעֹו֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־צַלְעֹ֖ו הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.ar: وَتَسْبِكُ لَهُ أَرْبَعَ حَلَقَاتٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَتَجْعَلُهَا عَلَى قَوَائِمِهِ ٱلْأَرْبَعِ. عَلَى جَانِبِهِ ٱلْوَاحِدِ حَلْقَتَانِ، وَعَلَى جَانِبِهِ ٱلثَّانِي حَلْقَتَانِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four feet thereof; and two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put [them] in the four corners thereof; and two rings [shall be] in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.web: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בַדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُ عَصَوَيْنِ مِنْ خَشَبِ ٱلسَّنْطِ وَتُغَشِّيهِمَا بِذَهَبٍ.
verses.en: And thou shalt make staves of acacia-wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make staves [of] shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.web: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

verses.he: וְהֵבֵאתָ֤ אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ בַּטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָאָרֹ֑ן לָשֵׂ֥את אֶת־הָאָרֹ֖ן בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: وَتُدْخِلُ ٱلْعَصَوَيْنِ فِي ٱلْحَلَقَاتِ عَلَى جَانِبَيِ ٱلتَّابُوتِ لِيُحْمَلَ ٱلتَّابُوتُ بِهِمَا.
verses.en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, wherewith to bear the ark.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.web: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

verses.he: בְּטַבְּעֹת֙ הָאָרֹ֔ן יִהְי֖וּ הַבַּדִּ֑ים לֹ֥א יָסֻ֖רוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.ar: تَبْقَى ٱلْعَصَوَانِ فِي حَلَقَاتِ ٱلتَّابُوتِ. لَا تُنْزَعَانِ مِنْهَا.
verses.en: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.
verses.kjv: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.web: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

verses.he: וְנָתַתָּ֖ אֶל־הָאָרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָעֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: وَتَضَعُ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ ٱلشَّهَادَةَ ٱلَّتِي أُعْطِيكَ.
verses.en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.web: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ כַפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָהֹ֑ור אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָחֵ֙צִי֙ אָרְכָּ֔הּ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי רָחְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.ar: «وَتَصْنَعُ غِطَاءً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ طُولُهُ ذِرَاعَانِ وَنِصْفٌ، وَعَرْضُهُ ذِرَاعٌ وَنِصْفٌ،
verses.en: And thou shalt make an ark-cover of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make a mercy seat [of] pure gold: two cubits and a half [shall be] the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.web: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ שְׁנַ֥יִם כְּרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצֹ֥ות הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُ كَرُوبَيْنِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ. صَنْعَةَ خِرَاطَةٍ تَصْنَعُهُمَا عَلَى طَرَفَيِ ٱلْغِطَاءِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt make two cherubim of gold; of beaten work shalt thou make them, at the two ends of the ark-cover.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make two cherubims [of] gold, [of] beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.web: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

verses.he: וַ֠עֲשֵׂה כְּר֨וּב אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב־אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֶת־הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י קְצֹותָֽיו׃
verses.ar: فَٱصْنَعْ كَرُوبًا وَاحِدًا عَلَى ٱلطَّرَفِ مِنْ هُنَا، وَكَرُوبًا آخَرَ عَلَى ٱلطَّرَفِ مِنْ هُنَاكَ. مِنَ ٱلْغِطَاءِ تَصْنَعُونَ ٱلْكَرُوبَيْنِ عَلَى طَرَفَيْهِ.
verses.en: And make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end; of one piece with the ark-cover shall ye make the cherubim of the two ends thereof.
verses.kjv: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: [even] of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.web: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

verses.he: וְהָי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֑יו אֶל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת יִהְי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَيَكُونُ ٱلْكَرُوبَانِ بَاسِطَيْنِ أَجْنِحَتَهُمَا إِلَى فَوْقُ، مُظَلِّلَيْنِ بِأَجْنِحَتِهِمَا عَلَى ٱلْغِطَاءِ، وَوَجْهَاهُمَا كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ إِلَى ٱلْآخَرِ. نَحْوَ ٱلْغِطَاءِ يَكُونُ وَجْهَا ٱلْكَرُوبَيْنِ.
verses.en: And the cherubim shall spread out their wings on high, screening the ark-cover with their wings, with their faces one to another; toward the ark-cover shall the faces of the cherubim be.
verses.kjv: And the cherubims shall stretch forth [their] wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces [shall look] one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
verses.web: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

verses.he: וְנָתַתָּ֧ אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶל־הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: وَتَجْعَلُ ٱلْغِطَاءَ عَلَى ٱلتَّابُوتِ مِنْ فَوْقُ، وَفِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ تَضَعُ ٱلشَّهَادَةَ ٱلَّتِي أُعْطِيكَ.
verses.en: And thou shalt put the ark-cover above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.web: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

verses.he: וְנֹועַדְתִּ֣י לְךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְדִבַּרְתִּ֨י אִתְּךָ֜ מֵעַ֣ל הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת מִבֵּין֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת אֵ֣ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֲצַוֶּ֛ה אֹותְךָ֖ אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ פ
verses.ar: وَأَنَا أَجْتَمِعُ بِكَ هُنَاكَ وَأَتَكَلَّمُ مَعَكَ، مِنْ عَلَى ٱلْغِطَاءِ مِنْ بَيْنِ ٱلْكَرُوبَيْنِ ٱللَّذَيْنِ عَلَى تَابُوتِ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ، بِكُلِّ مَا أُوصِيكَ بِهِ إِلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: And there I will meet with thee, and I will speak with thee from above the ark-cover, from between the two cherubim which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.kjv: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which [are] upon the ark of the testimony, of all [things] which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.web: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ שֻׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכֹּו֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבֹּ֔ו וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: «وَتَصْنَعُ مَائِدَةً مِنْ خَشَبِ ٱلسَّنْطِ طُولُهَا ذِرَاعَانِ، وَعَرْضُهَا ذِرَاعٌ، وَٱرْتِفَاعُهَا ذِرَاعٌ وَنِصْفٌ.
verses.en: And thou shalt make a table of acacia-wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.kjv: ¶ Thou shalt also make a table [of] shittim wood: two cubits [shall be] the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.web: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

verses.he: וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתֹ֖ו זָהָ֣ב טָהֹ֑ור וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לֹּ֛ו זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.ar: وَتُغَشِّيهَا بِذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ، وَتَصْنَعُ لَهَا إِكْلِيلًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ حَوَالَيْهَا.
verses.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ לֹּ֥ו מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ זֵר־זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתֹּ֖ו סָבִֽיב׃
verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُ لَهَا حَاجِبًا عَلَى شِبْرٍ حَوَالَيْهَا، وَتَصْنَعُ لِحَاجِبِهَا إِكْلِيلًا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ حَوَالَيْهَا.
verses.en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of a handbreadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.web: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לֹּ֔ו אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُ لَهَا أَرْبَعَ حَلَقَاتٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، وَتَجْعَلُ ٱلْحَلَقَاتِ عَلَى ٱلزَّوَايَا ٱلْأَرْبَعِ ٱلَّتِي لِقَوَائِمِهَا ٱلْأَرْبَعِ.
verses.en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that [are] on the four feet thereof.
verses.web: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

verses.he: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
verses.ar: عِنْدَ ٱلْحَاجِبِ تَكُونُ ٱلْحَلَقَاتُ بُيُوتًا لِعَصَوَيْنِ لِحَمْلِ ٱلْمَائِدَةِ.
verses.en: Close by the border shall the rings be, for places for the staves to bear the table.
verses.kjv: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
verses.web: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְנִשָּׂא־בָ֖ם אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُ ٱلْعَصَوَيْنِ مِنْ خَشَبِ ٱلسَّنْطِ وَتُغَشِّيهِمَا بِذَهَبٍ، فَتُحْمَلُ بِهِمَا ٱلْمَائِدَةُ.
verses.en: And thou shalt make the staves of acacia-wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the staves [of] shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.web: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ קְּעָרֹתָ֜יו וְכַפֹּתָ֗יו וּקְשֹׂותָיו֙ וּמְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֥ב טָהֹ֖ור תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُ صِحَافَهَا وَصُحُونَهَا وَكَأْسَاتِهَا وَجَامَاتِهَا ٱلَّتِي يُسْكَبُ بِهَا. مِنْ ذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ تَصْنَعُهَا.
verses.en: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and the pans thereof, and the jars thereof, and the bowls thereof, wherewith to pour out; of pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: [of] pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.web: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

verses.he: וְנָתַתָּ֧ עַֽל־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֛ן לֶ֥חֶם פָּנִ֖ים לְפָנַ֥י תָּמִֽיד׃ פ
verses.ar: وَتَجْعَلُ عَلَى ٱلْمَائِدَةِ خُبْزَ ٱلْوُجُوهِ أَمَامِي دَائِمًا.
verses.en: And thou shalt set upon the table showbread before Me alway.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
verses.web: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מְנֹרַ֖ת זָהָ֣ב טָהֹ֑ור מִקְשָׁ֞ה תֵּעָשֶׂ֤ה הַמְּנֹורָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣הּ וְקָנָ֔הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛יהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥יהָ וּפְרָחֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.ar: «وَتَصْنَعُ مَنَارَةً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ. عَمَلَ ٱلْخِرَاطَةِ تُصْنَعُ ٱلْمَنَارَةُ، قَاعِدَتُهَا وَسَاقُهَا. تَكُونُ كَأْسَاتُهَا وَعُجَرُهَا وَأَزْهَارُهَا مِنْهَا.
verses.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made, even its base, and its shaft; its cups, its knops, and its flowers, shall be of one piece with it.
verses.kjv: ¶ And thou shalt make a candlestick [of] pure gold: [of] beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.web: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

verses.he: וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִצִּדֶּ֑יהָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה ׀ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִצִּדָּהּ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִצִּדָּ֖הּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.ar: وَسِتُّ شُعَبٍ خَارِجَةٌ مِنْ جَانِبَيْهَا. مِنْ جَانِبِهَا ٱلْوَاحِدِ ثَلَاثُ شُعَبِ مَنَارَةٍ، وَمِنْ جَانِبِهَا ٱلثَّانِي ثَلَاثُ شُعَبِ مَنَارَةٍ.
verses.en: And there shall be six branches going out of the sides thereof: three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candle-stick out of the other side thereof;
verses.kjv: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.web: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

verses.he: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶרַח֒ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בַּקָּנֶ֥ה הָאֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃
verses.ar: فِي ٱلشُّعْبَةِ ٱلْوَاحِدَةِ ثَلَاثُ كَأْسَاتٍ لَوْزِيَّةٍ بِعُجْرَةٍ وَزَهْرٍ، وَفِي ٱلشُّعْبَةِ ٱلثَّانِيَةِ ثَلَاثُ كَأْسَاتٍ لَوْزِيَّةٍ بِعُجْرَةٍ وَزَهْرٍ، وَهَكَذَا إِلَى ٱلسِّتِّ ٱلشُّعَبِ ٱلْخَارِجَةِ مِنَ ٱلْمَنَارَةِ.
verses.en: three cups made like almond-blossoms in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three cups made like almond-blossoms in the other branch, a knop and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.kjv: Three bowls made like unto almonds, [with] a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, [with] a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.web: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

verses.he: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ׃
verses.ar: وَفِي ٱلْمَنَارَةِ أَرْبَعُ كَأْسَاتٍ لَوْزِيَّةٍ بِعُجَرِهَا وَأَزْهَارِهَا.
verses.en: And in the candlestick four cups made like almond-blossoms, the knops thereof, and the flowers thereof.
verses.kjv: And in the candlestick [shall be] four bowls made like unto almonds, [with] their knops and their flowers.
verses.web: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

verses.he: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְכַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּחַת־שְׁנֵ֥י הַקָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑נָּה לְשֵׁ֙שֶׁת֙ הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَتَحْتَ ٱلشُّعْبَتَيْنِ مِنْهَا عُجْرَةٌ، وَتَحْتَ ٱلشُّعْبَتَيْنِ مِنْهَا عُجْرَةٌ، وَتَحْتَ ٱلشُّعْبَتَيْنِ مِنْهَا عُجْرَةٌ إِلَى ٱلسِّتِّ ٱلشُّعَبِ ٱلْخَارِجَةِ مِنَ ٱلْمَنَارَةِ.
verses.en: And a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.kjv: And [there shall be] a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.web: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

verses.he: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶ֥ם וּקְנֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּ֣נָּה יִהְי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֹֽור׃
verses.ar: تَكُونُ عُجَرُهَا وَشُعَبُهَا مِنْهَا. جَمِيعُهَا خِرَاطَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ.
verses.en: Their knops and their branches shall be of one piece with it; the whole of it one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.kjv: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it [shall be] one beaten work [of] pure gold.
verses.web: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

verses.he: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְהֶֽעֱלָה֙ אֶת־נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔יהָ וְהֵאִ֖יר עַל־עֵ֥בֶר פָּנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.ar: وَتَصْنَعُ سُرُجَهَا سَبْعَةً، فَتُصْعَدُ سُرُجُهَا لِتُضِيءَ إِلَى مُقَابِلِهَا.
verses.en: And thou shalt make the lamps thereof, seven; and they shall light the lamps thereof, to give light over against it.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
verses.web: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

verses.he: וּמַלְקָחֶ֥יהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶ֖יהָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֹֽור׃
verses.ar: وَمَلَاقِطُهَا وَمَنَافِضُهَا مِنْ ذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ.
verses.en: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
verses.kjv: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, [shall be of] pure gold.
verses.web: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

verses.he: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָהֹ֖ור יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַכֵּלִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.ar: مِنْ وَزْنَةِ ذَهَبٍ نَقِيٍّ تُصْنَعُ مَعَ جَمِيعِ هَذِهِ ٱلْأَوَانِي.
verses.en: Of a talent of pure gold shall it be made, with all these vessels.
verses.kjv: [Of] a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.web: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.

verses.he: וּרְאֵ֖ה וַעֲשֵׂ֑ה בְּתַ֨בְנִיתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה מָרְאֶ֖ה בָּהָֽר׃ ס
verses.ar: وَٱنْظُرْ فَٱصْنَعْهَا عَلَى مِثَالِهَا ٱلَّذِي أُظْهِرَ لَكَ فِي ٱلْجَبَلِ.
verses.en: And see that thou make them after their pattern, which is being shown thee in the mount.
verses.kjv: And look that thou make [them] after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.web: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
